title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Esther 8: Mordecai receives the king's ring, a new decree goes out to every province, and the Jews rejoice.

questions.text: What did King Ahasuerus give to Esther the queen on that day?
questions.explanation: On that day King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews' enemy, to Esther the queen.

questions.text: What did the king give to Mordecai?
questions.explanation: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai.

questions.text: How did Esther plead with the king to put away the mischief of Haman?
questions.explanation: Esther fell down at the king's feet and begged him with tears to put away Haman's mischief.

answers.text: She sent Mordecai to speak for her
She wrote him a sealed letter
She fasted at the city gate
She fell at his feet and begged with tears

questions.text: What did the king hold out to Esther before she stood up?
questions.explanation: The king held out the golden scepter to Esther, and she arose and stood before him.

questions.text: What did Esther ask to be written?
questions.explanation: Esther asked that it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman to destroy the Jews in all the king's provinces.

answers.text: Letters reversing those devised by Haman
An order to rebuild the walls of Susa

questions.text: According to the king, what kind of writing may not be reversed by any man?
questions.explanation: The king said that writing written in the king's name and sealed with the king's ring may not be reversed by any man.

answers.text: Writing in the king's name, sealed with his ring
Writing read aloud at the gate

questions.text: In which month were the king's scribes called to write Mordecai's letters?
questions.explanation: The scribes were called in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day.

questions.text: On which day were the Jews allowed to gather and defend their lives?
questions.explanation: The letters allowed this on one day: the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

answers.text: The first day of the third month

questions.text: What did Mordecai wear when he went out from the presence of the king?
questions.explanation: Mordecai went out in royal clothing of blue and white, with a great crown of gold and a robe of fine linen and purple.

answers.text: Sackcloth with ashes on his head
A soldier's armor and a sword
A shepherd's cloak and a staff
Royal blue and white with a crown of gold

questions.text: What happened among the peoples of the land at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, because the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

answers.text: They rose up against the king
They burned the citadel of Susa
